stories.title: Flintshire Council tips could charge for soil, rubble and gas bottles to help cut overspend
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council could charge people for taking soil, rubble and gas bottles to its recycling centres under an option drawn up to help cut its overspend. stories.title: Flintshire Council heads for £8.5m overspend as reserves shrink
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council expects to overspend by £8.5m this year, which would cut the reserves it has not tied to specific projects to under £10m by March. stories.title: TG Jones, Poundstretcher and a collapsed Greenfield factory: £312,000 in Flintshire rates to be written off
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council could write off £312,550 in unpaid business rates owed by four firms. They include a Greenfield furniture maker that closed with the loss of nearly 300 jobs. Cabinet will be asked on Tuesday (13 October) to approve the write-offs. stories.title: Wrexham to Bidston trains disrupted until 9am after engineering works overrun
stories.summary: Trains between Wrexham Central and Bidston, serving Shotton, Hawarden and Buckley, may be delayed or cancelled until 9am on Thursday after engineering works were not finished on time. stories.title: Senedd backs cross-party calls to review Welsh funding formula
stories.summary: Senedd Members have backed calls to review Wales’ funding formula to increase fairness and transparency in how the nation is financed.
